geographic.title: Frozen first-look geographic transfer
geographic.interpretation: No target-area calibration. Models pool source-area annual counts before fitting. First-look locally frozen test, not externally blinded. Four selected areas do not establish global validity; after inspection this dataset is evaluation evidence, not an untouched future test.

independent.title: Independent MTBS event corroboration

attributes.comments: Fire severity could be misrepresented in wetland areas.

reference_manifest.reference: Landsat/Sentinel-2 postfire burned-area mapping with incident attributes
reference_manifest.limitations: Large mapped fires only; omitted/unmapped/small events are not negatives. Ignition dates do not specify fire cessation or pixel burning time.

independent.interpretation: Mapped-event corroboration only. A report inside the eventual burned perimeter is not proof it detected that specific event. Reference dates are day-resolution, windows are [ignition, ignition + N days), incomplete/small/unmapped fires are not negatives, and no precision/recall or true detection-latency claim is made.

coverage.interpretation: Decoded geolocated pixel visits for selected native swaths. Counts and cloud fractions are not area fractions, complete-day visibility, or NASA Aqua/VIIRS standard-product observation denominators. Unsampled space/time remains unknown. Classification is verified against file legends and alignment, not independently validated physical cloud truth.

metric_contract.unit: distinct platform x equal-area cell x UTC day, summed by month
metric_contract.policy: No target-region fitting, parameter selection, exclusion based on outcomes, or promotion after scoring. Missing/corrupt sources fail the region; no invented zeros. Report every case, including failures.

independent_validation.selection: All returned 2023 Wildfire polygons intersecting bounding box; no manual event selection
independent_validation.interpretation: Reference-event corroboration against independently mapped postfire footprints, not pixel recall, precision, exact ignition latency or burned-area estimation. Retain incomplete/invalid reference events.

coverage_pilot.source: NOAA-20 operational VIIRS I-band E-FIRE and matching terrain-corrected imagery geolocation
coverage_pilot.selection: All same-date granules whose full geolocated pixels enter the box; retain cloud, unknown, missing, bowtie, water and fire separately
coverage_pilot.limitations: NOAA operational QA does not verify NASA Aqua or VJ114IMG standard-product observation masks. This is a selected-day pilot, not historical/global QA completion.

protocol.integrity_note: Locally frozen first-look geographic evaluation; not independently blinded or externally timestamped. Freeze metadata alone is not tamper-proof.

aqua.interpretation: Native geolocated product-class samples only. Cloud and nonfire labels are product observations, not independently verified cloud/fire truth. Full-area/day coverage and pixel-area weighting are not established. Raw MODIS QA is not interpreted with NOAA bit meanings.
